hooks.prompt: Check if this command is a git commit or git checkout -b / git branch. If it is a git commit, verify the commit message starts with 'APP-{N}: ' where N is a number (Linear issue reference). If it is creating a new branch, verify the branch name matches 'feat/app-{N}-*' pattern. If the command is not git-related, ALLOW it. If it violates the convention, BLOCK it with an explanation. Command: $ARGUMENTS
